LanguageData.TXWC_TankCapacityDesc: How much chemfuel a full tank holds. The gauge counts it in units of one. Lowering it below a tank's current fill drops the excess. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_GasPerChemfuelDesc: How many cells of tox gas each chemfuel in the tank makes, however it is spent: vented, jetted, or burst when the pilot goes down. The absorb banks a chemfuel's worth per that much gas drawn in. A tox pack fills 45 cells from 35 chemfuel. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_VentRateDesc: How fast the vent empties the tank. A faster vent makes a wider cloud that clears sooner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_TankSummary: A full tank: {0} chemfuel for {1} cells of tox gas ({2} tox packs). The vent empties it in {3} seconds.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetCostDesc: How much chemfuel each gas jet draws from the tank. Without a tank, one of the shoulders' own jets makes the same gas for the same chemfuel. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetReserveDesc: How many jets the shoulders hold on their own, for wear without the tank. They reload with chemfuel and are untouched while a tank is worn. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetConeWidthDesc: The full width of the cone the gas jet lands in. A wider cone spreads the same gas thinner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetRangeDesc: How far the gas jet reaches. A longer jet spreads the same gas thinner. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetWarmupDesc: How long the pilot takes to aim the gas jet before it fires. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_JetSummary: A jet: {0} chemfuel for {1} cells of tox gas ({2} tox packs). A full tank holds {3}, the shoulders alone {4}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbRadiusDesc: How far around the pilot the absorb draws gas in. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbDurationDesc: How long each absorb keeps drawing gas in. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbCooldownDesc: How long the absorb takes to recharge. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.TXWC_AbsorbSummary: One absorb draws from the {0} cells around the pilot. A full cloud over them banks {1} chemfuel.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerTierDesc: Rebuilds the toxin warcasket at the 10th generation spacer tier, like the siegebreaker. It gains spacer armor and insulation, no speed penalty, toxic and psychic resistance, vacuum resistance{0}, and a shield bubble, but costs spacer components and plasteel and needs the spacer warcaskets research. Veteran raiders can wear it too. Default: off.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerShortDescription_Armor: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket shell with standard protection, fitted with a tox gas tank that vents around the pilot.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerShortDescription_Shoulders: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket pauldrons with standard protection, fitted with shoulder-mounted jets that spray tox gas from the shell's tank.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerShortDescription_Helmet: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, sealed behind a respirator that keeps out tox gas and draws it back into the shell's tank.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerLoreGeneration: 10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armour designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armours have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armour series even across generations.
LanguageData.TXWC_SpacerLoreSeries: The Toxin series is built for chemical warfare. A tank in the shell feeds vents around the pilot and gas jets on the pauldrons, and the helmet's respirator draws gas back into the tank. Together the pieces make the pilot immune to toxins.
LanguageData.TXWC_ToxinVacuumDesc: Gives the toxin warcasket the spacer tier's vacuum resistance, without the rest of the tier. Default: off.
LanguageData.TXWC_HazardVacuumDesc: Gives the hazard warcasket the spacer tier's vacuum resistance. Default: off.
LanguageData.TXWC_FeedToxAbsorptionDesc: A tank with gas in it counts as tox gas for pilots with the tox absorption gene ({0}), keeping their pollution mutations active. Costs no gas. Default: on.
